lines.en: label makiday351:
scene makimalldate1
: So...what exactly was it you wanted to talk to me about?
Maki and I walk silently through the halls of the mall for a short while and I can’t help but notice her looking a little distracted.
I don’t know if that’s just her tell for wanting me to buy her something but, if it is, she is in for a very rude awakening.
: Nothing in particular. I just figured you’d rather be spending time with someone who’s actually your age than following around a bunch of [teens].
scene makimalldate2
: It’s one thing to fill up on[teen]porn but, as a former [teenager] myself, I can confirm that almost all of them are confusing and irritating and-
: Exhausting.
: Yes. That as well.
scene makimalldate3
: Are you sure it’s okay to be saying that when you have a [teenage]daughter, though?
: Are you afraid she’ll jump out from behind a mannequin and call me a bad mother or something?
: Well it’s not like you two really have the best relationship to begin with, right?
scene makimalldate4
: Makoto and me? I think our relationship is great.

: It’s true that I have a hard time deciding how to tackle certain things, but as long as I have you as my stand-in husband until mine stops fucking aliens, I think everything will turn out just fine.
: Woah there. I never agreed to this whole “stand-in husband” thing.
scene makimalldate5
: Not five minutes into our marriage and you’re already asking for a divorce?
: Is it because you have to go to space? Because I’m already used to that and don’t mind at all.
: Enjoy your alien sex.
: Every day, your existence somehow manages to make me even more impressed by the head your daughter has on her shoulders.
: Well as long as it’s up there and not pressed between someone’s knees, I’m totally happy.
: I would like to take this opportunity to reiterate my previous statement.
scene makimalldate6
: Jokes aside, I’m glad that Makoto seems to be going back to her old self as of late.
: Actually, strike that. She seems truly happy for the first time since her father left as of late.
: Really? Because she kind of suffered a crushing defeat during her dorm wars contest thing and I thought it might get to her.
scene makimalldate7
: Did you talk to her about it?
: I didn’t see any reason to. That’s not something I should really get involved in.
: Well I did, so ha.
: Wow. Look at you being a real mom.
: I’ll have you know there’s not any minute of any day that I’m not a mom before anything else.
: It’s just a little difficult when your child imprints on your significant other instead of you.
scene makimalldate8
: But I digress.
: Makoto’s knowledge test thing crashing and burning may have even been good for her in a way.
: I don’t want to call it a wake up call or a...rude awakening or...any other phrase that involves waking up-
: But it’s kind of good to get the shit kicked out of you every once in a while.
: Are you asking me to mug your daughter?
: You’ll have to go through me first, Sensei.
: That doesn’t sound very hard.
: We’d probably get turned on while wrestling and wind up taking each other’s clothes off.
: You know, maybe I will mug your daughter after all.
scene makimalldate9
: Ahh, the things we do for love.
: Please don’t love me. There is not a single person we know who would approve of this relationship.
: Miku might.
: Miku is on Team Makoto now.
: As in she’s rooting for you to fall in love with my daughter?
: It appears that way.
: It appears that a spanking may be in order then.
: For me or for Miku?
: I don’t really want to be spanked.
: That’s what my actual husband thought at first.
: Be careful. Anything you say right now may one day be used against Makoto to embarrass her in front of class.
scene makimalldate10
: Oh please. She’s such a daddy’s girl that she could have walked in on me spanking him and still pinned the whole thing on me just...being too dominant.
: But to everyone's surprise, I'm actually an innocent and pure sub at heart.
: Yeah, I don’t believe that for one second.
scene makimalldate11
: Okay, fine. I was lying.
: But in my defense, being dominant is basically where all of my experience is.
: I haven’t really gotten many chances to play out any of my submissive fantasies because of my husband’s love for spanking and petplay.
: Having someone like you as a pet does sound like it would have its perks.
: Oh, no. He was the pet.
: We had a leash and everything.
scene makimalldate12
: Anyway.
: I’m sorry, Makoto. It looks like your classmates may soon find out that your father had a very different side than the one you grew up with.
scene black
Maki and I do a lap or two around the mall and manage to avoid contact with the group of girls I split up with earlier.
I’m not sure if the three of them have already gone home, but it’s starting to get dark and Maki is showing no signs of ending our gathering just yet.
I pull out my phone to text Ami about missing dinner but realize that she’s likely still with Ayane anyway-
So it looks like I’ll be able to dodge all suspicion entirely tonight and get to continue hanging out with a MILF.
Nice.
scene makimalldate13
: Hey...can I ask you something?
: You’re just going to ask anyway, aren’t you?
: Yeah. You said something that kind of made me upset earlier and I wanted to bring it up again before I hate myself for letting it go.
: You don’t actually think I’m a bad mother, do you?
: Because I’ve exhausted pretty much every resource available for Makoto. She’s just too annoyingly smart to really need someone like me.
: I didn’t really mean that. I was just using your words against you, really.
: I don’t remember ever calling myself a bad mother. That hurt.
: No. But you said that you might try to approach things more like a friend at times.
: And there’s also the issue of your...complicated relationship dynamic with your husband.
: Spanking your husband makes you a bad mom?
: What? No. The whole open relationship thing.
: What does that have to do with Makoto?
: Well...can you really say her environment was “normal” growing up?
scene makimalldate14
: I can, actually.
: Do you think we let her run around the store and use vibrators as rattles? Let her watch gangbang videos in the backroom while we kept an eye on the front?
: Do you think she was present for all of the times her father insisted on bringing a new girl home?
: Or do you think I, as a competent but slightly confused mother, would have kept my little girl away from that as best as I could?
: I think that Makoto is perceptive enough to figure things out even when they’re not right in front of her.
: And I think that she’s the type of person to measure her circumstances against those of others to try and figure out what “normalcy” is.
: So I’m a bad mother because my daughter is a genius?
: I already told you I didn’t mean that.
: Well then apologize.
scene makimalldate15
: Hey. If you’re going to be my stand-in husband, you’re going to have to realize when you’re in the wrong.
: I never agreed to-
: You don’t have to. Makoto’s already chosen you as her stand-in daddy, so now it’s all on you to live up to it.
: Can you call me daddy again please?
: Daddy.
: A little softer this time.
scene makimalldate16
: Daddy...
: Now do it like you’re about to cum.
scene makimalldate17
: Ahh! Daddy! Yes! Yes!
: Wow.
scene makimalldate18
: Teehee~
: There are a bunch of people looking this way now.
: Of course there are. I just came on a bench in a mall.
: Did you actually-
scene makimalldate19
: God, no. If it were that easy, I’d literally never leave home.
: Well it was very convincing and I hope for your husband’s sake that he never fell victim to your deceit.
: If he knew the amount of times he’d been deceived, I really would need a new husband.
: I’ll be sure to keep it a secret if he ever returns from the alien orgy.
scene makimalldate20
: If, huh?...
: Oh. I didn’t mean it like-
: No, no. I get it. I just don’t like hearing it out loud.
: The truth is that...and don’t tell Makoto I said this-
: But...I don’t really want to wind up waiting forever.
: I miss my husband. I really do.
: But there’s a point where you have to sort of just accept that things might not turn out how you wanted them to turn out.
: It’s painful not hearing from someone for years. Especially someone you spent so many years with.
: But I can’t do everything on my own.
scene makimalldate21
: I’m not like Sara or Haruka. I’m willing to accept my shortcomings and don’t want them to weigh me down.
: I’ve got a genius daughter to take care of. And, like you said earlier, she’s perceptive enough to realize things I don’t want her to.
: The second I start killing myself by working even harder is the second she starts killing herself as well.
: Well-
: And this isn’t me agreeing to be Makoto’s new father-
: But I’ll wind up supporting you in whatever you decide to do.
scene makimalldate22
: Oh my God. Did you just agree to become Makoto’s new father?
: Maki, I specifically stated-
scene makimalldate23
: Makoto’s going to be so happy that she won’t even mind hearing me yell “Daddy” over and over from the back room all night!
: No, I very much think she would mind that.
scene makimalldate24
: Thank you, Sensei.
: Not for the father thing, but for the support.
: You’ve done so much for Makoto and me in such a short time that I can’t help but feel like we owe a lot of ourselves to you.
: Is that-
: For once, I don’t mean that sexually.
Damn it.
: I mean that, in some way or another, you just being you is enough to keep Makoto afloat.
: And Makoto being afloat means that I get to be afloat.
: And before we know it, we’re all on the same raft together.
: Floating past nudist colonies and shielding that pure girl’s eyes from the things you and I as perverts see in our dreams.
I’m glad that Makoto is also smart enough to not reveal to her mother that she’s in an ongoing illicit relationship with her teacher.
I figure that must be difficult to do, but so many of my students are missing parents that it’s honestly hard to say.
scene makimalldate25
: I’m not suggesting anything here, but...
: Even if my husband does wind up coming back, I hope you’ll stick around.
: If not for me, then for Makoto.
: She really needs you.
: I’ll see what I can do.
scene black
Of course I have no intention of just skipping town and abandoning the Miyamuras...but it’s not like I could even if I wanted to.
The truth is that even though Maki and Makoto couldn’t be further apart in terms of personality, they’re still two of three cerberian heads.
The third, however, has been severed and is now floating somewhere out in space.
Maybe fucking aliens, maybe not.
There’s no way of knowing.
But at least I know that the other two heads are [[probably] safe for the indeterminate future.
